Run `terraform init` first — without it the `.terraform/` directory and `.terraform.lock.hcl` file do not exist yet.
Open `.terraform.lock.hcl` in your editor. The `provider` block's label (the quoted string after the word `provider` on that line) is the value for `lock_provider_source`.
Both locals end up being the same three-segment string: registry hostname, namespace, and provider type joined with `/`.
